[SWS_SM_00603] StateMachine service interface RequestTransition - not al-
lowed transition
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
The
RequestTransition
method shall return
kTransitionNotAllowed
if the
current state of the
StateMachine
is not configured for the
TransitionRequest
value in
TransitionRequestTable
and shall cease any further processing of the
request.
⌋
